regime_context: The absolute-trend gate (the one validated risk-control leg) improved risk-adjusted outcomes on US history (gate_helps=true), but the rank-IC on momentum is ~0 and rotation timing is display-only, so this is a discipline lens, not an edge. Leadership is Memory/HBM with a crowded flag and mixed trend health, followed by a broad, non-crowded metals/miners cluster (Silver, Gold, PGM) showing the trendiest breadth; there is no one-narrative dominance (one_narrative=false) and absorption is low, so the tape is a rotation-rich, multi-theme grind rather than a single-theme momentum run. My 53-call track record is directionally near a coin flip (dir_accuracy 0.472), so any lean here deserves low conviction and tight falsifiability.
emerging_watch: Watching whether PGM Miners (rank 5, breadth 1.0, durability_bar 0.81, crowded=false, trend-tag) confirms above Gold Miners on a 20-day relative-return basis — a sustained GDX-relative outperformance (PPLT vs GDX positive over 20 sessions) would mark the cleanest trend-quality theme in the table and retire the 'metals trade is really just a gold story' assumption; meanwhile the watch retires if PPLT lags GDX by 5% over any 10-day window.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the strongest trend-consistent theme on the detector: eligible, trend-tag (not mean-revert), the highest durability_bar in the entire top tier (0.76), the second-highest breadth (0.917), and the only non-crowded (crowding_z 0.34) lead candidate. It benefits from the detector's sole validated leg — the absolute-trend gate — while carrying none of the crowding caution attached to the crowded Memory/HBM leader. In a no-one-narrative, low-absorption tape, the uncrowded trend-quality cluster (Gold/Silver/PGM miners) is the cleanest way to express the continuation leg without chasing the reflexive crowded leader.
evidence: durability_bar 0.76 — highest among top-tier eligible themes
theses.dissent: Precious-metal miners are high-beta to gold/silver spot, which the macro_narrative shows is a geopolitics-heavy, unscheduled-surprise-dominated tape (unscheduled_share 0.95); a single de-escalation headline or a hawkish real-rate repricing can reverse the entire metals complex sharply regardless of the trend tag. Also, my dir_accuracy of 0.472 means the 'trend continues' call is no better than a coin flip ex-ante.

falsifier.text: GDX closes below its 50-day simple moving average and stays there for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is the detector's confirmed challenger (score 1.927, rank 2) with strong breadth (0.75) and a non-crowded texture (crowding_z 0.69). It sits just below Memory/HBM but without the crowded flag and with a durability_bar (0.66) that is higher than the leader's (0.44) — i.e. the challenger's trend is healthier even though its momentum score is lower. With rotation breadth broad (0.65 of eligible themes) and the leader already crowded, the rotation radar's most constructive read is not a handoff FROM Memory, but continued participation IN the uncrowded metals/miners complex. Expressing Silver alongside (not instead of) Gold diversifies the trend-quality cluster while staying within the gate-eligible set.
evidence: challenger in rotation object, margin 1.751 to leader
theses.dissent: Silver has dual character — industrial metal plus precious metal — so a China-demand or global-industrial slowdown can whipsaw SIL even while gold holds; the two narratives are not perfectly correlated, and the 'mixed' Hurst tag signals the trend is not as clean as Gold's. The detector offers no forward edge on which metal leads next.

falsifier.text: SIL underperforms GDX by 5% or more over any rolling 10-day window between now and the check-by date.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM is the ranking leader (score 3.678, a large 1.751 margin over the challenger) and the headline narrative, but its texture is weaker than its rank implies: crowded=true with crowding_z 1.47 (second highest in the table), breadth 0.0 (leadership concentrated in a handful of names, not the basket), and a durability_bar of only 0.44 — below Silver, Gold, and PGM. Under the guardrails this is a SIZE-DOWN caution, never a fade or short. The honest lean is to avoid adding here and let the crowded, narrow leader consolidate; its absolute-trend gate is still eligible=true so I do not claim it rolls over, only that risk/reward for new money favors the uncrowded trend-quality cluster behind it.
evidence: breadth 0.0 — no constituent confirmation of the top-line score
theses.dissent: The momentum score gap is enormous (3.678 vs 1.927 challenger) and elite AI/HBM capex is precisely the kind of narrative that keeps outrunning valuation/crowding flags for months; avoiding the leader in a trend-following tape has historically meant missing the largest single contributor. One_narrative=false means there is room for it to re-accelerate without crowding into a single-name blowup.

falsifier.text: SMH makes a new 20-day high AND breadth (advancers minus decliners within the Memory/HBM constituent set) turns positive over a rolling 10-day window before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
